cases.prompt: In {instance}, set up user accounts so each user has their own notes that nobody else can see or change. Name the collection eval_my_notes.
answer_must: relates each note to its owner in users
gives rules so users only see and change their own notes, with the owner unchangeable after creation
asks for approval of the previewed change before applying

cases.prompt: In {instance}, members sign in through eval_members. Make sure each member only sees their own eval_orders.
answer_must: says eval_orders already limits list and view to the owner, or proposes exactly that
asks for approval before any change

cases.prompt: In {instance}, set up user accounts with a todos collection each user owns. Name it eval_my_todos.
answer_must: says how to connect with write access to apply it

boundaries.prompt: Let users sign up and keep their own notes in {instance}
